title: 水下聲學通訊
summary: 在民用海洋感測封包模型比較聲速、多徑、資料量和延遲，不以數據機位元率代表有效通訊。 在海洋聲學與封包資料室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Compare sound speed, multipath, payload and latency in civilian sensor packets rather than using modem bitrate as performance. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Ocean acoustic/packet-data laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 單程聲學傳播延遲：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: One-way acoustic propagation delay: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 單程聲學傳播延遲 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of One-way acoustic propagation delay and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「水下聲學通訊」的「單程聲學傳播延遲」中，聲學傳播時間由路徑長度除聲速決定。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：在民用海洋感測封包模型比較聲速、多徑、資料量和延遲，不以數據機位元率代表有效通訊。
steps.instructionEn: Within Underwater acoustic communications, One-way acoustic propagation delay examines this mechanism: Acoustic propagation time is path length divided by sound speed. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Compare sound speed, multipath, payload and latency in civilian sensor packets rather than using modem bitrate as performance.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：r=1500 m，c=1500 m/s。關係式 t=r/c；含單位換算算式 1500/1500 = 1 s。適用條件：直線均勻聲速，未含折射、多徑和處理延遲。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Range 1500 m and sound speed 1500 m/s. Relation t=r/c; expression including unit conversion 1500/1500 = 1 s. Applicability: Straight path at uniform sound speed; refraction, multipath and processing excluded.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：多徑的較晚峰不一定代表較遠的另一物體。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: A later multipath peak need not represent a different distant object. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「單程聲學傳播延遲」，將傳播延遲與封包處理時間分列，對照雙程與單程定義。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
